provenance_rules: Retrieved means this producer opened the source at the read scope shown; internal means repository text, not external validation. Indexed/read bytes do not imply full semantic review.

primary_sources.title: Bernstein and Lange, Two grumpy giants and a baby
primary_sources.read_scope: Opened full PDF; read introduction and weighted-giant coverage discussion in section 6.
primary_sources.claim: Three-sequence generic collision geometry and published generic addition-constant comparisons.

primary_sources.title: Galbraith, Wang and Zhang, Computing elliptic curve discrete logarithms with improved baby-step giant-step algorithm
primary_sources.read_scope: Opened original journal page; read abstract and comparison table, not full proof.
primary_sources.claim: Average-case analysis and improved generic BSGS/grumpy comparisons already exist; they are prior work.

primary_sources.title: Esser and May, Low Weight Discrete Logarithms and Subset Sum in 2^(0.65n) with Polynomial Memory
primary_sources.read_scope: Opened full PDF; read abstract and section 3.1 fixed-weight/IID approximation and output-uniformity step.
primary_sources.claim: Low-weight representation collisions and carry propagation are prior work. The subset-sum exponent is not automatically a bound for arbitrary low-weight DLP instances.

primary_sources.title: Bernstein, De Feo, Leroux and Smith, Faster computation of isogenies of large prime degree
primary_sources.read_scope: Opened full PDF and read abstract/algorithm premise; also opened author project page.
primary_sources.claim: Square-root-Velu evaluation applies with a supplied rational kernel generator; it does not discover endpoints or supply kernels.

primary_sources.title: Teske, An elliptic curve trapdoor system
primary_sources.read_scope: Opened original full PDF; OCR limited, used only for the trapdoor/weak-endpoint architecture.
primary_sources.claim: Historical weak-endpoint transport architecture; no claimed transfer of the binary-field attack to prime fields.

primary_sources.title: Robert and Sarkis, Half differential additions on elliptic curves
primary_sources.read_scope: Opened full PDF, February 2025 version; read introductory construction and applicability of full rational 2-torsion formulas.
primary_sources.claim: Half differential addition factors point arithmetic through isogeny images; best specialized formulas require their stated torsion hypotheses.

primary_sources.title: Kieffer, Page and Robert, Computing isogenies from modular equations in genus two
primary_sources.read_scope: Opened full 45-page primary PDF and read abstract/known-endpoint reconstruction premise; detailed hypotheses require follow-up checking.
primary_sources.claim: Explicit genus-two isogeny reconstruction with supplied endpoint/type and modular data, not endpoint discovery.
